beats.say: Harry Kane won the Ballon d'Or in London.
This was the first time the prize came to London in 70 years.
70 years is roughly a full human lifetime.
Organisers chose the London Palladium for the ceremony on 26 October.
But the night did not start on time.
The BBC says traffic and crowds delayed the event by 45 minutes.
A lifetime of waiting for London ended with Harry Kane's first win.
That was Sport Shocks. Subscribe so you don't miss the next one.

facts: Harry Kane won the Ballon d'Or for the first time.
The Ballon d'Or had not been held in London in its 70-year history until 2026.
The ceremony took place on 26 October 2026 at the London Palladium.
The BBC reported that traffic and large crowds delayed the ceremony by 45 minutes.
